resources.string: Mark’s personal NOVA build · Edition 2 · 14 September 2026\nBased on NOVA 6.4.63 · heretoecode/aos-Video

Edition 2 — 14 September 2026

• Documentaries now has its own entry in the left navigation. It opens the existing documentary TV-show grid and remains visible before scanning.

• Slate blue theme: the original NOVA layout, with darker blue backgrounds, panels and focus colours. Blue and Black remain available.

• Streaming services: choose your country, your providers and a preferred provider in Settings. Film, show and episode details offer local playback, one provider and More providers. TV availability is for the show, so individual seasons or episodes may differ.

• Only subscription, free and ad-supported availability is listed. Rent and buy offers are excluded. Availability is supplied by JustWatch via TMDb.

• Title links open the provider app where supported. If no usable title link is available, Open provider explains the app or watch-page fallback. A subscription may still be required. NOVA does not play protected streams itself.

• Provider choices are saved separately per country. Lookup failures offer Retry and never block local playback. Private mode skips streaming lookups.

• About clearly identifies this personal build. Collection management remains groundwork from Edition 1; no new collection editor is included.
